title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Document, The Pharmacy Deductible
content:
## Article — The pharmacy deductible

**1. Claims subject to the deductible.** Under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan, a claim on a formulary tier that the design lists as subject to the deductible is paid in full by the member, up to the claim's allowed amount, until the deductible is met. Only then does tier cost share apply to the rest of the claim and to later claims. The design's individual deductible, family deductible, embedded or aggregate structure and list of tiers subject to the deductible are the member's own design figures.

**2. Claims that skip or never touch the deductible.** Drugs on the Northbridge Rx Preventive Drug List skip the deductible when the design provides that the Preventive Drug List skips it, and covered insulin skips it when the design provides that insulin skips it. Claims on tiers the design does not list never touch the deductible.

**3. Deductible remaining.** For employee-only coverage, the deductible remaining is the individual deductible less the deductible met, and never less than zero. For any other coverage level the family amount applies, under the Pharmacy Benefit Plan's family accumulation rule.

**4. Deductible portion of a claim.** The deductible portion of a claim is the lesser of the claim's allowed amount and the deductible remaining at the moment the claim adjudicates. Claims take their order from date of service and then from adjudication time. A design whose deductible is zero posts nothing to the deductible.

**5. Plan year.** Only pharmacy claims for dates of service on or after the current plan year's start date count toward the current plan year's deductible.

## Worked examples (hypothetical employee-only member, individual deductible 300.00)

| Deductible met before the claim | Deductible remaining | Allowed amount of a claim on a listed tier | Deductible portion (lesser of the two) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 300.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 |
| 220.00 | 80.00 | 150.00 | 80.00 |
| 300.00 | 0.00 | 90.00 | 0.00 |

In the second row the claim takes 80.00 of deductible, the deductible is then met, and tier cost share applies to the rest of that claim.

**Order of claims.** Two hypothetical claims on listed tiers, one with a date of service of 4 March and one of 5 March, are applied to the deductible in date-of-service order: the 4 March claim first. Two claims with the same date of service are applied in order of adjudication time.

## Points of judgement

| Claim | Touches the deductible |
|---|---|
| On a tier the design lists | Yes, until the deductible is met |
| On a tier the design does not list | Never |
| Preventive Drug List drug, design provides the skip | No — skips it |
| Covered insulin, design provides the skip | No — skips it |
| Date of service before the current plan year's start date | Does not count toward the current plan year's deductible |
| Any claim on a design with a zero deductible | Nothing posts to the deductible |
